tei:div.tei:p: (ba)༄༅// gnas brtan bcu drug la bstod pa bzhugs// ༄༅// dgra bcom blo mchog dbang dul ba// bstan pa srid du brtan bzhugs nas// 'dzin dang skyong dang srung mdzad pa// bcu drug bzhugs pa 'di lta ste// bha ra dh+wa dza bsod snyoms len// gser can ba ku la dang ni// lam bstan rdo rje mo yi pu// sbed byed sgra gcan 'dzin dang ni// klu sde gnas brtan yan lag 'byung*// nags na gnas dang ma pham pa// lam phran bstan dang gser phreng dang*// mi phyed pa dang dus ldan dang*// de bzhin bzang po zhes bya ba// de dag rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/// / ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
